notes.title: MATM: Rogue mode is out! (v1.1)
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! MATM: Rogue mode is out now for $1.99 (With a 25% sale ːsteamhappyː)[/p][p][/p][p]This DLC was months in the making, and completely changes the game in an alternate game mode (it is basically a new game!)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606422/79b7d58c9a29721ffb78950334e2b9a158e8c55b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]I hope this update marks a new era of this game. I will continue to update rogue mode (adding new items, systems, meta progression, and more!)[/p][p]I really hope to see this game expand, and I can't wait to see the future of this game! [/p][p]There is so much content in this DLC (I would say about 10-20 hours worth), and it will be awesome to see everyone's reaction to it all![/p][p][/p][p]Here are the patch notes for the v1.1 update, and Rogue mode as a whole![/p][p][/p][p][b]V1.1 (Available to all)[/b][/p][p][b]ACHIEVEMENTS ARE TEMPORALLY DISABLED FOR THIS PATCH[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Reworked the logic behind the main menu, hopefully making modifiers and settings more consistent[/p][/*][*][p]Added some banners for Rogue mode[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a lot of crashes involving failed achievement triggers [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a collision issues, allowing uncle to take flight[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the game manager unloading, soft locking the player in the error scene[/p][/*][*][p]Added custom music wizard (Feature is not fully done, there are still a [i]lot [/i]of issues still needed to be fixed). If the ingame button to open the files does not work, go to the file path [b]C:\\Users\\<Your computer name>\\AppData\\LocalLow\\RasberryPi (Found by using Windows+R in the run app)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some logic issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash while finishing Mount Dagobert ([i]Oops[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Completely changed the logic behind saving and loading, making wins save more constantly[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the collection screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added daily challenges (these reward you with meta currency for rogue mode) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a lot of other issues that are too small to list[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p] [b]DLC PATCH NOTES [/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new game mode, Rogue mode[/p][/*][*][p]Added 35 new items (all of them can be found in the collection screen)[/p][/*][*][p]Added 20+ Cosmetics[/p][/*][*][p]Added 20+ map chunks[/p][/*][*][p]Added the vending machine[/p][/*][*][p]Added meta progression for rogue mode[/p][/*][*][p]Added 2 rogue mode exclusive modifiers[/p][/*][*][p]Added 5 star levels, each making the game MUCH harder[/p][/*][*][p]Added 12 unlockable jobs (Upgrade your starting area and find the static TV to get hints on how to unlock them)[/p][/*][*][p]Added ragdoll cams[/p][/*][*][p]Added a lot of QQL exclusive to Rogue mode[/p][/*][*][p]Added lore???!??!?!?![/p][/*][*][p]There is so much more, but I can't spoil everything, so go ahead and try it out![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Onkleville times #7

notes.title: Onkleville times #6
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Uncles (That's how I am going to start my post now)[/p][p][/p][p]Here is the next installment of the Onkleville times![/p][p][/p][p][b]Firstly, DLC news[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I am at a point in development were I could release the DLC any day, and would feel confident about it,[/p][p]but.....[/p][p]I am adding things like polish, some smaller features, and updating the main game to be more fun![/p][p][/p][p]All Beta versions will now be called [/p][p]"[b]Release candidates[/b]"[/p][p][/p][p]These versions are mostly finished versions that can be launched, but will have more and more improvements to boot![/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, I have reached my goal for items and map stages, I will not be adding more items until the DLC launches, but I will be adding more map stages. This is to hopefully prevent any issues with OP items ruining the game on launch, and to give myself room for future content![/p][p][/p][p][b]Next, some FAQs that my beta testers and friends asked[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Will the main game get an update?[/b][/p][p]A: Yes! The update will have TONS of bug fixes, some systems (such as cosmetics) will be available in a lite form, and you will be able to earn the meta currency (Onkle tokens) for a few cosmetics, and keep them if you decide to purchase the DLC, and a lot of QQL will be present![/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: Do cosmetics work in both modes?[/b][/p][p]A: Yes, all cosmetics work in the main game, as well as rogue mode[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: How will rogue mode work, is it a modifier, a special mountain, or another app[/b][/p][p]A: Rogue mode is present in the map select, so a special mountain I guess. The fundamentals are different between the modes, so kinda.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What is the gameplay like?[/b][/p][p]A: Really fun, it has the same challenge (with ways to make it easier/much harder) as the main game, and somewhat of the same gameplay, but it feels unique. I have played a few games you could consider "Rogue like/lite platformers", and it feels very different. There are no stages, but each chunk can feel like one. It has a sort of build management, allowing each run to feel different, but unlike other roguelikes, one style of build is much better than others.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What are your plans post launch?[/b][/p][p]A: Everything is a maybe, I have another project that will start around them, but I did leave myself some space to expand the DLC. There MIGHT be more items, there MIGHT be more stages, but it all depends on the success and what the community wants![/p][p][/p][p][b]Q: What does the monetization look like in Rogue mode?
[/b]A: [b]Just the upfront cost of $1.99 USD, maybe in the future, I will make another DLC, but not micro transactions.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I am more than excited (more than the other post because the game feels like a cohesive experience)[b] [/b]to share this with y'all. Only 16 days to go![/p][p][/p][p][b]August 20th, 2025[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]If you play in the 10 days post launch, you will unlock a special skin! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860700/The_Mountain_and_The_Moron_Rogue_Mode/?curator_clanid=45606422"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][i]See you at the top[/i][/p][p]-RasberryPi[/p]

notes.title: Onkleville Times #4
notes.notes: [p]Hello! RasberryPi here![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606422/f3a74ab6a7408eff9e12ad03dba1a80951b935ce.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]I have done some work on the DLC in the past week (or just work I haven't shared). And development is going great![/p][p][/p][p][b]Firstly, the difficulty system![/b][/p][p][/p][p]I have created a difficulty system for the game. I am thinking about adding a endless run system, but that might come later on (there is a lot of balancing that I would have to do to make that work). Anyways, the difficulty system. There are 5 unique difficulty modifiers that are enabled every time you beat the game. They reset every time you close the game or whenever you feel like it (this is to force you to do them in either one sitting, or with small breaks, they are meant to be reset). [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606422/fa8316a685b1574d647d5df7a17db1941e1542f5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, I have added Fame, a better version of score, doing things, especially risky earn Fame. You earn more fame at higher levels, but you cannot earn fame without wining for the first time![/p][p]This will hopefully be a good high score system, better then the existing score system. [/p][p][/p][p][b]But to talk about other things[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I have been cooking up some new items, my goal for launch is 35, and eventually updating it to 50 (<--- this may not happen depending on what I have time for, only time will tell). I have added an active item system that is strange, but surprisingly fun. I always liked but disliked games like TBOI or Risk of Rain 2's active item system, it is cool and creates fun limits only being able to hold one item, but I tried that, and it just did not fit the faster pace this DLC is running with. I also tried binding each on to a unique key, but the game quickly felt like a MMO, with all of the keybindings. So in a discord call with some friends, I had the stupid idea of binding all of the active items to a single cool down and key, and it created this chaotic system that fit the game well. It makes using the active item feel like a risk in it's own right. [/p][p][/p][p]I will continue to update y'all on any new additions, so look out![/p][p][/p][p][b]Now somethings that I would like to add, but may or may not![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Nothing here is set in stone, let alone something more solid then the gray matter that writes the code the game runs on. But anyways,[/p][p][/p][p]I would love to add [b][i]MULTIPLAYER[/i][/b] to the main game, just because it would be fun. There would be a lot of jank, and I would have to redo the entire movement controller, but I don't mind. This would come after the DLC, but hey, leave me some feedback about that in the comments for this post, I would love to read that![/p][p][/p][p]Second thing I may not have the time for! skins! No, not mircotransactions, there will be no "[i]Unlcepass[/i]". Instead something to reward players for reaching some goal, not achievements (there will be none for the DLC because steam still does not support DLC achievements [i]VALVE[/i]), but like a crown if you beat the game, something small like that. I will try to add that, but we will see![/p][p][/p][p][b]Some final words![/b][/p][p][/p][p]This DLC has been a blast to work on, and I am super excited to publish it![/p][p]So hey, go and wishlist the DLC! I know this is like the most cringe thing to say, but it [i]really really[/i] helps, Steam is more likely to show the game to new people, and that is my main goal![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860700/The_Mountain_and_The_Moron_Rogue_Mode/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][i]See you at the top[/i][/p][p]-RasberryPi[/p]

notes.title: Onkelville Times #3
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p][b]Welcome to the 3rd Onkelville times, it's been a while, the game has been out for a few months now![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606422/f3a74ab6a7408eff9e12ad03dba1a80951b935ce.png"][/img][/p][p][b]First thing first, THANK YOU![/b][/p][p][/p][p]MATM has reached 25k downloads, this is crazy. I never thought this game would get any more than a few hundred.[/p][p]I hope we can keep growing this game, and this upcoming announcement should help![/p][p][/p][p][b]A few days ago...[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Some people may have seen the post I made a few days ago. It may have been strange, a black image and something cryptic about fruit. It does have a meaning. [/p][p][/p][p]Go into photoshop and increase the saturation, or just keep reading, I have the same announcement lol.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]THE DLC[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I would like to announce the first DLC for MATM is coming soon TM (still in development)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606422/fff93099b2aba45186ea98d9a73cc4930891d258.png"][/img][/p][p]The Mountain and the Rogue Uncle![/p][p][/p][p]Yes! A rogue-like mode for MATM.[/p][p][/p][p]While I was working on this game, people talked about the game's perma death element a lot and kept comparing it to games like The Binding of Issac, and Risk of Rain 2. I always said that the game was never going to become a roguelike because the project was just not built around it. I still have no idea how someone would think a silly game about an uncle is like Risk of Rain. [/p][p][/p][p]Originally I was going to make another game, based off on a project I made for a CS class, in Java Script (same thing most websites use for buttons and the like). But that project did not really go anywhere. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606422/5b6a3a5b28bdcbc43102a44c36d9d004c2ba55d1.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Ah, yes, a slot machine[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Maybe in the future, but I have other ideas >:)[/p][p][/p][p]But anyways, this DLC will also come with some smaller fixes here and there, but will mainly consist of a "chunk based map" and items that you collect to make your way to the top. It also will have some difficulties to change up the gameplay. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606422/4a80f10a78b4770b9dc334985397fb27a34bc313.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Ragdoll cam on death[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606422/664d95f148cd37e28cd1dcb7c52d0a1783df8cbb.png"][/img][/p][p][i]WIP inventory UI[/i][/p][p][/p][p]I am super excited to show off some of the cool things the DLC adds. I also can't wait to see everyone's reaction to everything.[/p][p][/p][p]But there is one catch[/p][p][/p][p][b]The DLC will cost $1.99 USD[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I don't know how else to say this, but because of the work on this project, and the potential to become sustainable making video games, I have to monetize this one. I priced it at $1.99 because it is about the cost of a soda, making it much easier to afford, and having the game be free makes it harder to monetize.[/p][p][/p][p]I can not wait to talk more about the DLC, so go ahead and wishlist it now! (even if you don't buy it, it helps out a LOT as steam recommends it to more people!)[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860700/The_Mountain_and_The_Moron_Rogue_Mode/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][i]-PS, beta testers can access a VERY WIP build in the beta branch right now![/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]See you at the top[/b][/p][p]-RasberryPi[/p]

notes.title: The Onkleville Times #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606422/f3a74ab6a7408eff9e12ad03dba1a80951b935ce.png[/img]

[b]Hello everyone, this is the first edition of the Onkleville times!
[/b]
The Onkleville times is a (Hopefully) weekly until the game's release, then monthly update on MATM, here I will have updates on the games development, upcoming news, announcements, (if the community grows) community contributions (such as videos, fan art, and more), and some ending notes.
[b]To start, let me talk about some updates I am working on![/b]

I have added a new modifier, this modifier adds a bomb to the bottom left corner of the screen that explodes, destroying the entire mountain once its timer runs out. This is different from the "soft timer" that Rising Void adds. The idea behind adding an optional "hard timer" is it makes the player feel different about their use of time. Players often lose after they fall in Rising Void, but the "hard timer" gives you more grace when you fall, but still will punish you. I hope the 10 minuets the timer is set to is fair. 
Additionally, I have locked Mount Dagobert behind 1 win, this should prevent people from going to Mount Dagobert as their first stage.
Otherwise, that is all for the gameplay changes. 

[b]Upcoming News/Announcements[/b]

I am still trying to release the game in late May/Early June, the only real thing I have left before the game is done is music. Desh is doing the music for this game, if he is not able to finish the tracks in time, I will use stock music for the time being. I will share samples if he has it done by the next entry of The Onkelville times.

[b]Since the game is not out yet, the community hub is mostly silent...[/b]

[b]Ending Notes[/b]
I hope this weekly (for now) news will help with transparency, and show ya'll what i'm working on! I will most likely post the patch notes for v0.9 soon, I have a few more plans for 0.9, so look forward to it!


-RasberryPi

notes.title: The Mountain And The Moron's Steam page is live!
notes.notes:
Hello y’all, I'm RasberryPi. I am a new game developer, and this is my first game published on Steam!

[b]How did we get here?[/b]

I started work on MATM back in January of this year for a school project, and never expected to publish the game anywhere (yet alone Steam). As time went on, the game started to overshadow everybody else's game, and this led to multiple people saying “You should publish the game on steam”.

As time went on, I felt more and more confident about doing so, and also wanted to learn how. So I ponied up and paid the $100, and spent hours figuring out how to publish the game. And now we are here!

[b]The game is not out yet, when will you release it?[/b]



My goal is late May, or early June. A few things such as the music are not done yet, and I still am using placeholder music , and I still want to add a few things (such as more achievements, and getting them working lol). I am working hard to get it ready by then !

[b]What even is MATM?[/b]

The Mountain and the Moron is a rage platformer!

[b]How did you get the idea behind this game?[/b]

It’s a weird story. Originally, Uncle was just a dancing pickup that spun around the map, and the main character was a gray cylinder (as most unity projects start). 
One thing led to another and Uncle ended up as the main character because he was rigged properly, so I could use him. The mountain came from an idea of someone climbing a mountain while the news was recording him. Originally the camera came from news, but that system made the game nearly impossible. The game as of now is hard, but not super bad, which modifiers can change the game to make it easier/harder.

[b]Will there be multiplayer? I really want multiplayer! MULTIPLAYER WHEN?[/b]

Yes, yes I know, multiplayer is fun.

But on the other hand

This game is not programmed for multiple players, synced across a server. I will explore options (Upgrading the game to Unity 6 may be helpful for this), but as of now, No. (it would be fun though)

[b]Ending notes[/b]

I am super excited to release MATM for y'all to play. I will post frequent updates on the game’s development (these news articles take like 30 minutes to make, and give you guys a little window into my life). Yet again, I will try to release the game in early summer, so stay tuned!

-RasberryPi
